title: Questions on using xDrip with Dexcom G6
body:
Hello 
I hope this is the right place sorry if not.

I use xDrip+ since months with FSL2, OOP and AAPS.
I just started using Dexcom G6 in France.
At the hospital, they had me install the Dexcom app and also the app MyDiabby where they can follow my data.  This app gets data from the Dexcom, using another app: Clarity.

I heard that since june, your app can get data directly from the Dexcom but I'm not sure of the version I have, is there two different xDrip, can I simply upgrade... 
Also, I wonder if you had tests or feedback of cases where we can continue using MyDiabby and Clarity ? 
Attached is my version of xDrip.

Thanks for all the great work.
